name: Dirk Bender

biography: With more than 25 years of experience in the IT, telecommunications, and digital infrastructure industries, I am passionate about helping organizations transform, scale, and innovate through technology.Throughout my career, I have built trusted relationships with customers, developed high-performing teams, and led complex strategic engagements across enterprise and multinational accounts. My approach combines customer-centricity, strategic thinking, and a strong focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.As a sales leader, I believe that sustainable success starts with people. I am committed to creating an environment built on trust, accountability, continuous learning, and mutual respect. By empowering individuals to grow professionally and personally, I help teams achieve exceptional results while maintaining a strong culture of collaboration and engagement.Today, I lead a team of sales professionals at Equinix, responsible for driving growth and customer success across the High-Tech, Automotive, Media, Travel, Transportation, and Logistics sectors in Germany. Together, we help organizations accelerate digital transformation by leveraging Equinix's global platform, enabling secure, resilient, and interconnected digital infrastructure at the edge, across clouds, and throughout rich business ecosystems.I enjoy engaging with business and technology leaders who are exploring how digital infrastructure, hybrid multicloud architectures, AI, connectivity, and ecosystem partnerships can unlock new opportunities and competitive advantages.Let's connect and exchange ideas on the future of digital business, leadership, and innovation.
